title: Publications, Preprints, and Manuscripts
intro: This page separates public preprints, technical manuscripts, and manuscripts in development. Status labels are intentionally explicit so that early-stage work is not presented as peer reviewed or published when it is not.

entries.title: Sensor-Level EEG Residual Prediction of Temporal Reproduction Bias
entries.description: A Research Square preprint examining whether trial-level EEG information explains residual variation in time reproduction beyond behavioural structure already captured by duration, context, and recent experience.

entries.title: A Bayesian Log-Time State-Space Clock for Human Time Reproduction
entries.description: An SSRN preprint presenting a Bayesian log-time state-space account of human time reproduction with explicit attention to central tendency, multiplicative variability, prediction, and diagnostic model adequacy.
entries.topic: Bayesian modelling · time reproduction · state-space dynamics

entries.title: NeuroLab OS: A local-first software environment for scientist-reviewed neural time-series modelling and provenance-aware simulation
entries.description: A technical manuscript describing a local-first scientific workbench for neural time-series ingestion, explicit quality control, computational model fitting, in silico perturbation workflows, and provenance-aware reporting. A complete journal-style full-text article view is available on this site.

entries.title: A Graph-Theoretic Framework for Representing Spacetime as Temporal Layers of Spatial Graphs
entries.description: An exploratory theoretical preprint representing spacetime as ordered layers of spatial graphs, with emphasis on discrete structure, temporal layering, invariance, and graph-based modelling.

entries.title: Cortical State Dynamics Support a Near-Linear Physiological Proxy for Temporal Inference Across fMRI, EEG, and Simulation
entries.description: A systems-neuroscience manuscript on cortical-state dynamics and temporal inference across fMRI, EEG, and simulation. The public site presents the research direction without disclosing unpublished analyses beyond the material already made public.

entries.title: Band-Specific Sensorimotor Topographies During Temporal Reproduction: A Non-Circular EEG Validation Study
entries.description: An EEG manuscript under revision following editorial feedback on sensor-space topographic interpretation and figure presentation. It remains a manuscript rather than a peer-reviewed publication.
entries.topic: EEG topography · sensorimotor dynamics · temporal reproduction
